Hey neighbor! 

Just wanted to drop you a line and say hi. I noticed the flowers you planted in front of your house are absolutely blooming! The colors are so vibrant and it's been such a nice pop of color in our little neighborhood. Makes me smile every time I walk by. Hope you're enjoying them as much as I am. Cheers! - [Your Name] 

Feel free to reply if you're in the area and want to take a look. I'd be happy to chat and show you around. 

Take care! [Your Name] [Your address] [Contact info if you want to be available
